name: Jellyfin
description: Free media server for your films, series, music and photos, with apps for TVs, phones and browsers.

volumes.name: cache
volumes.description: Transcoding and image cache (can be deleted).

inputs.label: Media folder
inputs.help: An existing folder on this PC with your films, series or music, e.g. D:\Media. Mounted read-only at /media.

inputs.label: Second library folder
inputs.help: Optional, e.g. D:\TV. Mounted read-only at /media2.

inputs.label: Third library folder
inputs.help: Optional, e.g. D:\Music. Mounted read-only at /media3.

inputs.label: Use an NVIDIA GPU for transcoding (experimental on Docker Desktop)
inputs.help: Needs an NVIDIA card with a current Windows driver; Intel Quick Sync and AMD are not available in Docker Desktop.

privileges.explain: Only when you enable the NVIDIA option: the container gets access to the GPU through Docker Desktop's WSL 2 GPU support.

security: Streaming video through Cloudflare's proxy or Tunnel is restricted by Cloudflare's terms: keep Jellyfin local only (or use your own connection), and use Cloudflare only for occasional, low-volume access.
Create the administrator in the setup wizard right after the first start.

update.notes: Read the release notes before major versions: the library database is migrated on start.

exposure.warning: Media streaming through Cloudflare is restricted by its terms. Publishing Jellyfin through the tunnel is not recommended.
